sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.note: The fullest guide read: 3-step roadmap (story 60–80 h, 100% checklist ~100 h, cleanup ~10 h), difficulty 4/10, ~200 h, 1 playthrough, 0 online, no mission replay. Flags Positive Mental Attitude as the only possibly missable trophy and says plainly it is still unconfirmed whether the balcony meditation is required.
sources.title: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap

sources.name: KeenGamer
sources.note: Full guide with the same 3-step roadmap and the same headline numbers (4/10, ~200 h, 1 missable). Gives the balcony sequence step by step (after Down to Earth, Lucia at Jason's house in the morning) and says outright that Ten Pin's precise method is still being confirmed.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap – All 55 Trophies

sources.name: GTABase
sources.note: Full guide and list: ~200 h, 1 playthrough, no mission replay, cheats disable trophies. Confirms Positive Mental Attitude as the only possibly missable trophy and that stranger questlines return after the story.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)

sources.name: eGamers
sources.note: List plus honesty: names and descriptions are taken from outlets whose lists agree, and anything not confirmed in two sources is marked unconfirmed. Gives the hidden split by grade (27 visible, 28 hidden; 1 hidden gold, 27 hidden bronze).
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements, Plus The Hardest Ones

sources.name: Push Square
sources.note: Work-in-progress guide; the dissenting voice on time — up to 300 hours or more, against the ~200 h the other guides give. Also confirms the 100% checklist opens after the story and that 15 of 18 card sets feed it.
sources.title: GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap (WIP)

sources.name: sixshore
sources.note: List and roadmap: platinum at about 200 to 250 hours or more. Gives the per-trophy counts used here (397 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 8 bank vaults, 9 activity types) and the hidden split (12 story + 16 hidden side trophies).
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: All 55, Missables and Roadmap

sources.name: GTA Vibes
sources.note: List with the same headline numbers (~200 h, 4/10, 1 playthrough, 0 online, 1 possible missable). Groups the list by story, side missions, crime and activities, which is how the stages here are grouped.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

sources.name: GTASpotter
sources.note: Full official list plus roadmap notes: the balcony meditation cannot be done until both characters are playable after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), and the questlines that are Lucia-only (Andy) or Jason-only (Tyrone and Bret) are flagged.
sources.title: GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

sources.name: GTASnaps
sources.note: A summary of PowerPyx's guide rather than fresh reporting — labelled ECHO, not a second witness. Useful for the dispute: it states that some other guides rate the platinum 7/10, and confirms 18 meditations across 10 locations and the 15-manual-save habit.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap: Platinum Difficulty, Missables and Hidden Trophies

sources.name: Exophase & PSNProfiles
sources.note: The official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via the Exophase and PSNProfiles mirrors (also carried in the competition kit). Cited by all 55 guides: the list itself is the one fact every source agrees on.
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophies — official list mirror (names taken 18 Nov from Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles)
